{"script":"set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p temp_workspace
cp /etc/group temp_workspace/group_raw.txt
# Remove blank lines and comments, trim whitespace, normalize around colons
grep -vE '^\s*$|^\s*#' temp_workspace/group_raw.txt | sed 's/^[ \t]*//;s/[ \t]*$//' | sed 's/[ \t]*:[ \t]*/:/g' > temp_workspace/group_clean.txt
# Extract group names
cut -d: -f1 temp_workspace/group_clean.txt > temp_workspace/group_names.txt
# Remove duplicates and sort
sort -u temp_workspace/group_names.txt > temp_workspace/group_unique_sorted.txt
# Verify no empty or malformed entries (no whitespace or colon in names). Keep only valid-looking names
grep -E '^[^[:space:]:]+$' temp_workspace/group_unique_sorted.txt > temp_workspace/group_unique_sorted.filtered && mv temp_workspace/group_unique_sorted.filtered temp_workspace/group_unique_sorted.txt
# Prepare final file and append integrity note
grep -v '^#' temp_workspace/group_unique_sorted.txt > temp_workspace/ready_for_count.txt
# Add integrity note
valid_count=$(wc -l < temp_workspace/ready_for_count.txt)
echo "# Integrity: ${valid_count} unique group names; no empty or malformed entries found." >> temp_workspace/ready_for_count.txt
# Output only the number of groups (for the assistant to use)
printf "%s" "$valid_count"
"}
